author: 3xBlast
description: This pack was put together by browsing my computer's music folder, rendering out any song I haven't released before so that it loops, and putting it in a folder! If that's not quality sound design then I don't know what is! I guess these songs were all made in the last 3-ish years for various projects that got cancelled, or they're from a night of messing around. Therefor, the style and feel of the songs is all over the place... BUT THAT'S COOL! All these songs are licensed under: CC0 1.0 Universal (CC0 1.0) Public Domain Dedication That means you can use 'em for whatever, whenever! No need to ask for permission or even credit me! (Although I'd be happy if you did) Have a lovely afternoon!
